details.publicNotes:
Mortarfish are gigantic, magma-dwelling fish that hunt prey by firing mortars of superheated rock from their mouths. They are often aggressively territorial, shooting magma at anyone who enters their hunting grounds. They can be reasoned with, but they're prone to attacking and devouring anyone that doesn't immediately announce their presence and offer tribute. Even fire giants must take care when approaching magma channels claimed by a mortarfish school.

Mortarfish are particularly proud of their ability to shoot magma precisely over a long distance. They frequently hold competitions, with the mortarfish whose shots are most accurate being granted leadership of the school. The targets for these contests are often ferrous crab swarms, and each mortarfish is entitled to eat whichever crabs they've killed. These rowdy events are often mistaken for volcanic activity.

Mortarfish typically hunt alone, but they return to their school regularly to care for their young and compete. The largest schools of mortarfish swim through the primeval volcanoes on the elemental planes where the first of their kind were born, but planar travel has allowed schools to colonize volcanoes across the Universe.

Disorderly Ordnance

With long-distance attacks that can level a citadel, mortarfish are coveted allies for fire giants and others with dreams of elemental conquest. However, mortarfish can be troublesome troops at best. Too undisciplined to be left to their own devices and too belligerent to be frightened into obedience, they are likely to ignore their commanders' objectives in favor of interesting targets of opportunity. One of the best ways to get mortarfish to stick to a particular task is to stress its difficulty: mortarfish will go to any lengths to prove doubters wrong.

description.value: The mortarfish thrives in molten rock. They can breathe in lava or magma in addition to air. Additionally, while submerged in lava or magma, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks.
Smoke doesn't impair a mortarfish's vision; they ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

Requirements The mortarfish is about to make a mortar shot Strike while they have a creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in their jaws

Effect The mortarfish loads the creature onto the mortar shot. When they make the Strike, they launch the creature into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the attack's target; this is forced movement. If the creature was restrained, it lands @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The launched creature takes the mortar shot's splash damage.

Requirements The mortarfish is swimming in lava or magma

Effect The mortarfish unleashes a wave of molten rock. All creatures in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] take @Damage[12d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save). Creatures that fail the save also take @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] damage. The mortarfish can't use Magma Wave again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Magma Wave]]{1d4 rounds}.

Requirements The mortarfish is swimming in lava or magma

Effect The mortarfish draws molten rock into their mouth, forming it into a ball to prepare a mortar shot. If they do not currently have a creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in their jaws, they can also attempt an Athletics check to grab a creature of size Large or smaller within 10 feet in their jaws. Mortar Reload is the only way that a mortarfish can reload their mortar shot.

Frequency once per minute

Effect The mortarfish spews a cloud of volcanic smoke in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] centered on themself. This smoke cloud remains for 1 minute. When a creature starts its turn in the smoke cloud or enters the smoke cloud, it takes @Damage[3d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save). All creatures in the smoke become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within it. This smoke can be dispersed by a strong wind.
